parameters.value: A note sorting machine, or currency sorting machine, is a machine that sorts and counts notes with high efficiency and accuracy. These machines can sort notes based on denomination, authenticity, condition, and various other criteria.

The note sorting machine will feature an aesthetically pleasing design and robust construction, ensuring it remains stable and undistorted during operation. All rotating and moving parts will operate smoothly and securely. Key components of the note sorting machine include an appropriate motor, various sensors such as UV, Twin CIS and others as desired in the machine etc with some gear, belts, housing, and output stackers/pockets depending upon the size of the machine for sorted notes and rejected notes. The machine is equipped with necessary safety devices to prevent accidents during use.
Twin CIS (Contact Image Scanner)/Coloured Twin CIS (Contact Image Scanner) +UV (Ultra-Violet Light/Fluorescent Scanner) + IR (Infra Red Scanner) + MG (Magnetic Sensor) + Thickness Sensor
